title: What is a nation?
goal: Read about the difference between a state and a nation, and use relative clauses with a preposition to describe the country and the community people belonged to.

items: Use *el que*, *la que*, *los que* and *las que* after a preposition to describe the country or community people belonged to.
Say the difference between a state and a nation.
Say what Benedict Anderson meant by an imagined community.
Say why the new republics had to build a nation.
Use the key words of this lesson: nation, nationalism, member, inhabitant, rural, automatic and false.
